messages:
lucas: Heads up, saw a weird billing mismatch where overage spikes pointed at proj-B but traces show orig proj-C.
maria: saw same. any recent edge changes?
kevin: we deployed edge-async v2 last night. it does non-blocking auth exchange and writes a provisional attribution header while waiting for final exchange.
rachel: provisional header looks like `X-Auth-Attr: provisional=proj:C;req=xyz123` and router charges immediately.
ankur: router is intentionally stateless for performance, so it can't retroactively change the charge when exchange finishes.
lucas: so options: (1) block routing until exchange (bad latency), (2) make provisional immutable at edge (breaks some flows), (3) signed short-lived proof + reconciliation.
maria: I prefer 3. preserves latency and gives a way to correct.
kevin: propose header `X-Auth-Proof: v1;id=xyz123;kid=auth-reg-1;ts=1680000000;hmac=BASE64` where hmac = HMAC(kid_key, req_id|proj|ts). TTL 20s.
ankur: exchange posts final assertion with same req id. reconciliation job consumes both and emits correction events to billing. start in read-only first.
billing-bot: billing policy: final charge must be applied within 24h and include both provisional proof and final proof in audit log.
rachel: UX: console shows small "provisional" tag on quota charts and a corrections counter. org admins can set "provisional charge cap" to limit leakage.
kevin: security: KMS-managed signing keys per region, rotate via existing endpoint. replay protection via req_id+short TTL.
sre-bot: INF-901 created: "deploy HMAC verification in router" assigned @kevin.
lucas: telemetry: new metrics auth.proof.verify_ms, auth.provisional_charges, auth.reconciliation_corrections. add alert if corrections_rate > 0.001 for 10m.
maria: rollout plan: A) edge emits proof header B) router accepts provisional to org-pool and records event C) reconciliation runs read-only for 48h on internal orgs D) 1% external canary E) enable corrections.
ankur: also consider charging provisional to org-pool instead of project to avoid misbilling during transient delays.
billing-bot: create BILL-412 for correction schema and GL mapping.
rachel: docs: add SDK snippet `client.setAuthProof(reqId)` and console messaging about corrections.
kevin: tests: unit HMAC gen/verify, integration with KMS rotate, e2e with delayed exchange callback.
lucas: RFC pushed in PR #3847, please review.
maria: action items: KEVIN router verify + tests, ANKUR reconciliation consumer (read-only), RACHEL console badge + cap UI, LUCAS coordinate RFC + canary.
kevin: one more: set proof TTL conservative: 20s default but make config per-org.
maria: ok. security review and postmortem write-up if we see mischarges during canary. thanks all :thumbsup:
